name: Ochrona przyrody - Bioróżnorodność (Olsztyn)

funder.name: WFOŚiGW w Olsztynie (Warmia-Masuria regional environment fund)

summary: Regional grants in Warmia and Masuria for active nature protection in protected areas, species and habitat protection, nature inventories and protection plans. The 2026 round has ended.

amount.note: Up to 150,000 zł per project in protected areas; up to 80,000 zł elsewhere
